name: Thyme

low.description: About 1 tablespoon fresh or 1 teaspoon dried

siboNotes: Thyme is naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated. Its antimicrobial compounds may actually support digestive health.
preparationTips: Strip fresh thyme leaves by running fingers opposite direction of growth
Add dried thyme early in cooking to allow flavor to develop
Fresh thyme can be added near end of cooking for brighter flavor
Store fresh thyme in refrigerator wrapped in damp paper towel
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in vitamin C and antioxidants
